1.1.evidence:
For the purposes of this law, domestic violence means any inaction or intentional action of physical, sexual, psychological, economic, social, spiritual or cyber violence, which occurs in the family or domestic environment or between spouses or former spouses, as well as between current or former partners, regardless of whether the aggressor resides or has resided together with the victim.
(1) Domestic violence manifests itself in the following forms:a) verbal violence - addressing through offensive, brutal language, such as the use of insults, threats, degrading or humiliating words and expressions;b) psychological violence - imposition of will or personal control, causing states of tension and psychological suffering in any manner and by any means, through verbal threats or in any other way, blackmail, demonstrative violence against objects and animals, ostentatious display of weapons, neglect, control of personal life, acts of jealousy, constraints of any kind, unlawful stalking, surveillance of the dwelling, workplace or other places frequented by the victim, making telephone calls or other types of communications through remote transmission means, which through their frequency, content or moment they are made create fear, as well as other actions with similar effect;c) physical violence - bodily harm or harm to health through hitting, pushing, slamming, hair pulling, stabbing, cutting, burning, strangling, biting, in any form and of any intensity, including those disguised as being the result of accidents, through poisoning, intoxication, as well as other actions with similar effect, subjection to exhausting physical efforts or to activities with a high degree of risk to life or health and bodily integrity, other than those referred to in letter e);d) sexual violence - sexual assault, imposition of degrading acts, harassment, intimidation, manipulation, brutality with a view to maintaining forced sexual relations, marital rape;e) economic violence - prohibition of professional activity, deprivation of economic means, including deprivation of primary means of subsistence, such as food, medicines, necessities, the action of intentional misappropriation of the person's property, prohibition of the right to own, use and dispose of common property, inequitable control over common property and resources, refusal to support the family, imposition of hard and harmful work to the detriment of health, including to a minor family member, as well as other actions with similar effect;f) social violence - imposition of isolation of the person from family, community and friends, prohibition of attending educational institutions or the workplace, prohibition/limitation of professional achievement, imposition of isolation, including in the common dwelling, deprivation of access to the living space, dispossession of identity documents, intentional deprivation of access to information, as well as other actions with similar effect;g) spiritual violence - underestimation or diminishment of the importance of satisfying moral-spiritual needs through prohibition, limitation, ridicule, penalization of family members' aspirations, of access to cultural, ethnic, linguistic or religious values, prohibition of the right to speak in one's mother tongue and to teach children to speak in their mother tongue, imposition of adherence to unacceptable spiritual and religious beliefs and practices, as well as other actions with similar effect or similar repercussions;h) cyber violence - online harassment, online messages instigating gender-based hatred, online stalking, online threats, non-consensual publication of information and intimate graphic content, illegal access to intercept communications and private data and any other form of abusive use of information and communication technology through computers, smartphones or other similar devices that use telecommunications or can connect to the internet and can transmit and use social or e-mail platforms, with the purpose of shaming, humiliating, frightening, threatening, silencing the victim.
